India has condemned the string of attacks that have taken place in the Black Sea region
in the last one or two days.
Briefing media in New Delhi, External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Anthi Jayaswal said,
such attacks threaten commercial shipping and endanger the lives of seafaring communities.
He added that a commercial vessel MV Royad Mamadoff came under attack while it was
flying in the Black Sea. There were three internationals on board, and all of them are safe, but one
of them was injured and is receiving medical treatment. The second trip, a Togo-flagged

After nearly three-and-a-half years, the Reserve Bank of India, RBI Today, raised
the key benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%. In a bid to contain rising inflation amid
continuing global and geopolitical uncertainties, the last repo rate hike was in February 2023
when the RBI raised the rate by 0.25% to 6.5%. It kept the rate unchanged through 2023-24
before beginning its rate cut cycle in 2025. Announcing the bi-monthly monetary policy,
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the monetary policy committee unanimously decided to raise the
policy repo rate by 25 basis points. The RBI also projected real GDP growth for the current
financial year at 7.1% with growth projected at 7.2% in the second quarter, 6.9% in the
quarter and 6.8% in the fourth quarter. This is Aakash Varni. You are listening to the news at 9.
